title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - CommunicationNetwork
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/CommunicationNetwork. A communication network (ttl rdfs:comment). subClassOf s4syst:Connection, saref:FeatureOfInterest.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CommunicationNetwork'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasGateway.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/hasGateway'. Links a communication network to its gateway, the communication interface of a device. ttl-confirmed, domain CommunicationNetwork, range CommunicationInterface.
